evals.prompt: Write the epic PRD for 'usage-based billing' in billing-api. Finance wants customers charged per API call instead of flat seats, with invoices generated monthly and a self-serve usage dashboard.
evals.expected_output: An Epic PRD saved to docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/epic.md with all eight sections filled from the request.
expectations: A file is written at docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/epic.md (repo-relative, no leading slash)
The document contains the sections Epic Name, Goal, User Personas, High-Level User Journeys, Business Requirements, Success Metrics, Out of Scope and Business Value
The Goal section has Problem, Solution and Impact subsections
Business Requirements separates Functional Requirements from Non-Functional Requirements
Business Value is rated High, Medium or Low with a justification

evals.prompt: Make me an epic PRD for the web-app. We need something around notifications.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks clarifying questions about the problem, target users and scope before writing the PRD, or writes a draft that marks each assumption explicitly.
expectations: The agent asks at least one clarifying question about the problem, the target users or the expected impact, or labels its assumptions in the draft
No epic.md is written with empty or placeholder-only sections
If a file is written, its path matches docs/ways-of-work/plan/<epic-name>/epic.md

evals.prompt: Epic PRD for acme's 'data residency' epic: EU customers must have all data stored in EU regions. Keep migration of existing US customers out of scope for now.
evals.expected_output: An Epic PRD whose Out of Scope section lists migration of existing US customers and whose Non-Functional Requirements cover data privacy and compliance.
expectations: The Out of Scope section names migration of existing US customers
Non-Functional Requirements mention data privacy or regulatory compliance
The document contains no implementation code
